content_of_post_to_comment: It is interesting to note how, in Paul's letters to the early church, he recommends radical forgiveness, bold confrontation of sin to root out immorality, abuse, and false teaching, as well as unity and mercy, to struggling churches, as opposed to "taking a break from the church," or a "just me and Jesus" mentality. Instead, he talks about how the church is a body that needs each member in order to function and flourish. And some of those early churches were pretty messed up. If those Christians weren't supposed to just walk away, then maybe we aren't either?
